person_note: The novel uses an external third-person omniscient narrator with shifting focalization among an ensemble; changes in viewpoint do not change grammatical person. The sustained licensed opening and two independent whole-book analyses agree, while q00757 supplies quote-level corroboration. Apparent first-person evidence is local: q00753 uses a generic human “we,” and q00759 is Colonel Cascio’s dialogue despite its event bucket. No evidence supports sustained first-, second-, or alternating-person base narration; the main residual limitation is that most supplied event quotations are too context-poor to be independently diagnostic.
